gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ to your advice — then I would not be in this mess.
gaps.hint: regret about the past, past perfect
gaps.explanation: 'Wish' plus the past perfect expresses regret about the past: had listened.

gaps.sentence: If only I ___ faster — we might still catch the train.
gaps.hint: if only plus could, present inability
gaps.explanation: 'If only' plus 'could' expresses a present inability you regret: could run.

gaps.sentence: If the walls ___ soundproofed, we would not hear the neighbours.
gaps.hint: unreal present with the subjunctive were
gaps.explanation: Unreal present conditions formally take 'were': were.

gaps.sentence: Unless something urgent ___, I will be at my desk all morning.
gaps.hint: unless introduces the exception, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces the exception to the plan and takes the present simple: comes up.

gaps.sentence: We will refund the item provided that you ___ the receipt.
gaps.hint: provided that plus a present requirement
gaps.explanation: 'Provided that' states a requirement using the present simple: have.

gaps.sentence: If you ___ me tonight, I will send you the files first thing.
gaps.explanation: A realistic future condition uses the present simple after 'if': email.

gaps.sentence: He always carries a power bank in case his phone ___.
gaps.hint: in case plus the present simple
gaps.explanation: 'In case' takes the present simple for things that might happen: dies.

gaps.sentence: As long as you ___ the rules, you will have no problems here.
gaps.hint: as long as states the condition
gaps.explanation: 'As long as' introduces the condition and takes the present simple: follow.
